hypothesis_provenance.economic_rationale: Low-volatility / low-risk anomaly (Blitz-van Vliet; Frazzini-Pedersen betting-against-beta; Bali lottery-demand): leverage- and lottery-constrained investors overpay for high-volatility, high-attention names, so low-volatility stocks earn higher risk-adjusted returns. China A-share evidence (Robeco 'The Volatility Effect in China'; behavioral beta-anomaly studies) finds the low-risk premium is driven by volatility rather than beta, is behaviorally (lottery-demand / idiosyncratic-volatility) rather than leverage driven, remains strong in the largest and most liquid names, and exhibits low turnover.

frozen_design.hypothesis_text: In a PIT A-share main-board top-500 large-cap universe (reusing the reviewed circ_mv materialization, the 000043 exclusion, and the reviewed full-main-board daily adj_factor total-return close series), low_volatility (the negative of each name's trailing 252-trading-day realized volatility of daily total returns, an externally-motivated low-risk-anomaly signal) produces positive cost-adjusted excess versus CSI300 over a 504-trading-day hold, surviving HAC-t, cohort, sub-period, concentration, and PIT-hygiene gates (the statistical-alpha-clue tier). Tradeability additionally requires the strategy's rolling-overlapping-portfolio relative-NAV drawdown versus CSI300 to be no worse than -15% (the tradeable-candidate tier) - the same gate the cash_conversion clue failed, kept frozen and unchanged so low_volatility is held to the identical bar. low_volatility is motivated by external A-share low-risk-anomaly literature and by the observation that three prior frozen tests cleared or failed on the drawdown / tradeability axis; it is NOT derived from an in-sample diagnostic of a prior run, so it does not carry cash_conversion's in-sample-factor-selection caveat, but it is still tested on a single historical period (2018-2025) and a positive result is a research clue pending forward-live evidence. If the single primary cell fails the statistical-alpha-clue gates, large-cap low_volatility is falsified under this frozen design.

sub_period_robustness.rationale: 504d holds need a complete forward exit and the trailing 252d volatility window removes the earliest as-ofs, so cohorts are bounded at both ends; split the valid 504d-forming entry cohorts at their median into two equal halves, not by natural calendar years.

risk_gate.relative_drawdown_threshold_rationale: frozen at the identical -0.15 bound the cash_conversion clue failed, unchanged and pre-committed before observing low_volatility's NAV; because the benchmark is the same-schedule CSI300 tranche portfolio, this drawdown isolates stock selection from benchmark-path mechanics, and holding low_volatility to the same bar is the point of the test (its thesis is precisely a better downside profile).

required_output_diagnostics: Report the one primary cell and its two-tier verdict: statistical-alpha-clue gates separately from the tradeable-candidate relative-NAV-drawdown gate.
Report the full-sample HAC t-stat and each sub-period half's mean excess and HAC t-stat; both halves' mean excess must be positive for the alpha-clue tier.
Report the rolling-overlapping-portfolio relative-NAV (strategy / CSI300) max drawdown and, as diagnostics only, the absolute strategy NAV max drawdown.
Report CSI300 primary and CSI1000 diagnostic without requiring both benchmarks for the alpha-clue label.
Report 504d primary and 252d diagnostic forward horizons; the 252d forward horizon is distinct from the 252d trailing volatility lookback and cannot rescue a primary failure.
Report idiosyncratic_volatility_vs_csi300_low and downside_semideviation_low as diagnostics; no diagnostic factor can define alpha or rescue the primary.

Report the trailing-window coverage per as-of and the startup months excluded from cohort formation for insufficient trailing history, and confirm those excluded months are disjoint from the primary cohort as-of set.
Report top-500 PIT market-cap coverage, marginal industry-neutral coverage, and marginal size-neutral quintile coverage for cohort-forming months, and top-count-by-month.
Report the reviewed 000043.SZ / 20191129 data-quality exclusion and confirm the signal universe drops it and backfills the next main-board name by circ_mv before scoring.
Report yearly contribution, name concentration, and tail excess.
Report no raw rows, endpoint results, request URL, or secret in any tracked summary.

statistical_alpha_clue: A future reviewed run may label large-cap low_volatility as a research-only statistical alpha clue only if the single primary cell is positive net of costs versus CSI300, has HAC t-stat >= 2.0, at least 48 monthly cohorts, both sub-period halves with positive mean excess, and passes name / year concentration and PIT-hygiene gates.
The statistical-alpha-clue tier does not require the relative-NAV-drawdown gate; it is a statistical finding only.
tradeable_candidate_research_only: A statistical alpha clue is additionally labeled a research-only tradeable candidate only if the rolling-overlapping-portfolio relative-NAV (strategy / CSI300) max drawdown is no worse than -15%.
If the alpha-clue tier passes but the relative-NAV-drawdown gate fails, the result is a statistical alpha clue but NOT a tradeable candidate.
Even a tradeable-candidate label is research-only and cannot authorize production, ship-gate evidence, or full-size manual use.
falsified: If the primary cell fails any statistical-alpha-clue gate, large-cap low_volatility is falsified under this frozen design.

Do not rescue a failed primary cell from CSI1000, 252d, non-neutral, cap-weighted, diagnostic factors, an alternative trailing window, idiosyncratic-volatility, threshold, horizon, or benchmark changes.
diagnostics_policy: CSI1000, 252d, non-neutral, cap-weighted, idiosyncratic-volatility, downside-semideviation, and the absolute-NAV drawdown are reporting diagnostics only.
Diagnostics may inform a later new preregistration, but only through a new reviewed ledger update and user approval.
provenance_caveat: low_volatility is externally literature-motivated and is NOT derived from an in-sample diagnostic of a prior run, so it does not carry cash_conversion's in-sample-factor-selection bias; this is a cleaner provenance.

It is nonetheless tested on a single historical period (2018-2025) and was selected at the program level after three prior spent singletons, so the singleton ledger and a new reviewed preregistration bound but do not eliminate program-level multiple testing.
Real validation requires the unchanged forward-live ship gate; an in-sample pass is a research clue only.

limitations: This artifact registers a design only; it executes no signal search and fetches no data.

low_volatility is externally literature-motivated rather than in-sample-diagnostic-derived, so it avoids cash_conversion's factor-selection caveat, but it is still tested on a single 2018-2025 historical period and a positive result is research-only pending forward-live evidence.
It was chosen at the program level after three prior spent singletons; the new singleton ledger bounds but does not eliminate program-level multiple testing.
Statistical power is limited: 504d holds plus the trailing 252d volatility window bound cohorts at both ends, so the HAC t-stat rests on a short effective sample (roughly 2019-2023 entry cohorts).

Industry neutralization is effectively SW-L1 (sector) level on the top-500 because SW-L2 groups rarely reach the minimum count; a residual low-volatility-sector tilt (for example banks / utilities) is controlled but may not be fully removed.
There are two distinct 252-trading-day axes: the trailing volatility lookback used to build the signal and the 252d diagnostic forward holding horizon; they must not be conflated.
The relative-NAV-drawdown threshold is a pre-committed bound, not an optimized value, and gates only the tradeable-candidate label, not the alpha-clue verdict.
A positive future backtest remains research-only until the unchanged project ship gate, including at least 12 months of forward-live evidence, is satisfied.
